title: An F.P. Journe Becomes the Most Expensive Watch Ever Sold at Auction in France, Because of Course

sources.title: An F.P. Journe Becomes the Most Expensive Watch Ever Sold at Auction in France, Because of Course
Antiquorum proves brass can be worth more than gold with this F.P. Journe

stop_reason: Missing core facts. Robb Report (the trusted source) redirects to a tollbit host that does not resolve, so its text could not be read. Time+Tide Watches gives only starting bids (CHF 400,000 and CHF 200,000) for the Antiquorum Octa Calendrier lots, with no hammer price, no fee status, no sale date and no lot reference. A search found no Paris or French sale record for an F.P. Journe, so the 'most expensive in France' claim is unverified. The AUCTIONS format needs a hammer price, fee status and a date. Stopped without rendering. Next step: the owner or a later run should fetch the Robb Report article directly or the Antiquorum sale results for the exact lot, price, fees and date.
